Carpet Installers


About the Role
Lay and install carpet from rolls or blocks on floors. Install padding and trim flooring materials.
What You'll Do
Inspect the surface to be covered to determine its condition and correct any imperfections.
Roll out, measure, mark, and cut carpeting to size with a carpet knife, following floor sketches.
Join edges of carpet and seam edges where necessary by sewing or using tape with glue.
Cut and trim carpet to fit along wall edges, openings, and projections.
Plan the layout of the carpet, considering traffic patterns and seam placement.
Stretch carpet to align with walls and ensure a smooth surface.
Take measurements and study floor sketches to calculate the area to be carpeted.
Install carpet using adhesive where required.
Clean up before and after installation.

Tools & Technology
Flooring estimating software (Project management software)
RFMS Schedule Pro (Scheduling software)
Microsoft Excel (Spreadsheet software)
Education & Experience
Education: High school diploma or equivalent or Less than high school diploma
On-the-Job Training: 2 to 4 years
Related Work Experience: 1 year to 2 years
Work Environment
Spend time kneeling, crouching, stooping, or crawling
Indoors, environmentally controlled
High time pressure
